# Nikhil Jain

> Growth and GTM engineering at Osmos.ai, and a former D2C founder. This site documents what I build in public: essays on GTM engineering, AI and agent workflows, D2C, and performance marketing; reusable AI skills you can open in Claude, ChatGPT, or Perplexity; a prompt library; quotes; and an open-source Pipedrive MCP server. Written in a plain, first-person voice with no marketing fluff. Contact via LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhiljain726/) or Topmate (https://topmate.io/nikhiljain726).
